metadata.note: Chart annotations. Frontend filters by `features` array and `countries` array before rendering. Range events (start != end) render as vrect bands; point events as vline.

events.label: Global Financial Crisis
events.description: Financial crisis → global trade collapse. Finland hi-tech exports fell ~48% in 2009.

events.label: Nokia decline → Microsoft acquisition
events.description: Nokia (~20% of Finland exports in 2007) collapsed; mobile business sold to Microsoft in 2013–14. Finland hi-tech exports halved; R&D intensity fell 3.7% → 2.75%.

events.label: Eurozone sovereign debt crisis
events.description: Italian spreads spiked, GDP fell. R&D% rose mechanically (GDP in denominator) while exports stagnated.

events.label: COVID-19 pandemic
events.description: Trade disruption; both countries saw export volatility and GII declines.

events.label: Italy export surge (+55% in 3y)
events.description: EUR/USD swing + defence/electronics boom. Italy hi-tech exports rose from $45B → $60B.

events.label: GII first published (Italy)
events.description: Global Innovation Index data begins for Italy in 2011.

events.label: GII first published (Finland)
events.description: Global Innovation Index data begins for Finland in 2013.
